subject: Calibration with BIB - Balanced Incomplete Blocks

messages.author: 83e0e4b2af20986a
messages.subject: Calibration with BIB - Balanced Incomplete Blocks
parts:
Dear Phil and partners,

I would like to know how I calibrate the items when I have 3 test books with 10 items each and with two items in common between them.
Ex.
TB1 and TB2 common items 5 and 6.
TB2 and TB3 common items 7 and 8.
TB3 and TB1 common items 1 and 2.

Thank you very much

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Calibration with BIB - Balanced Incomplete Blocks
parts:
Look into the multipleGroup function. You'll want to treat the common items as anchor items across groups, and there will be a good degree of NA values for items that were not answered. 

Phil
